programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: An inspector gets suspended for his irascible behaviour. The situation worsens when he gets framed for the murder of an ex-politician's son and must prove his innocence.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Jaane Jigar
programme.desc: Two women look identical but hail from different backgrounds. They fall in love with Ravi and Vijay who are best friends. Misunderstandings arise when they believe they are in love with the same girl.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot attempts to solve a murder while on a luxury cruise down the famous Egyptian river. Mystery, based on the Agatha Christie novel, directed by and starring Kenneth Branagh, with Gal Gadot, Annette Bening and Armie Hammer.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Spy
programme.desc: A deskbound CIA agent provides valuable background support for a dashing secret agent, but has never gone into action herself. Everything changes, when the spy mysteriously vanishes, and she leaps into action to take his place, infiltrating the inner circle of a ruthless arms dealer and trying to avert a global catastrophe. Comedy adventure, starring Melissa McCarthy, Jason Statham and Rose Byrne.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Piglet's Big Movie
programme.desc: The plucky porker is upset when his friends tell him he is too small to come honey-harvesting with them, so he embarks on an adventure of his own - and it is not long before his pals start to miss him and realise just how important he is. Animation, featuring the voices of John Fiedler, Jim Cummings and Andre Stojka.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Beach Blanket Country BoilKardea Brown hits the beach with friends for some fun in the sun and a summer-perfect picnic featuring a low-country boil, fresh peach arugula salad and sparkling summer lemonade.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: S1 E35 — Crab Bolognese and Mexican BLTCrab bolognese with crunchy fennel salad, plus Mexican BLT, chillies, guacamole and salad.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: S1 E36 — Cajun Steak and Chicken TikkaJamie Oliver cooks Cajun steak, smoky baked beans and collard greens, plus chicken tikka, lentil, spinach and naan salad.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: S3 E1 — Misty CopelandIna Garten toasts the arrival of ballerina Misty Copeland with Kir Royale cocktails as the pair chat over herbed ricotta bruschetta; Misty shows Ina her family's favourite go-to dinner, citrus salmon and mashed butternut squash.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S13 E4 — Mexican WeekThe bakers explore authentic Mexican bakes, as they put their twist on the sweet bread pan dulce for the Signature, tackle a Mexican street food staple in the Technical, and make their own showstopping version of the milk-soaked tres leches cake.

programme.title: Rachel Allen: Bake!
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Meringue Roulade/Sweet SconesRachel makes a meringue roulade with cherries and rosewater mascarpone, and visits a master baker.

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Celebration CakesChef James Martin prepares cakes for special occasions - Black Forest gâteau and a white chocolate celebration cake.

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: S1 E9 — TartsJames Martin presents some fantastic recipes to delight the sweetest of teeth with fantastic tart ideas: custard tart, treacle tart, a prune and almond tart.

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Ice CreamOne of Britain's premier pastry and pudding makers - James Martin prepares vanilla and meringue ice cream, instant banana ice cream and mango sorbet.

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: S1 E11 — FestiveFestive desserts come under the spotlight, with parkin, vanilla fudge, an Easter egg and cranachan.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers' Comfort Food
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Spice It UpSi and Dave cook dishes guaranteed to turn up the heat. They have a spicy new take on a family favourite with their roasted spiced cauliflower cheese, and they take inspiration from the Caribbean with a plate of jerk pork chops.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E5 — TequilaIt's tequila all the way as Ree makes a meal using a whole bottle of tequila. On the menu is queso fundido con tequila, shrimp tortilla soup with a shot of the good stuff and berries with tequila cream. And a cocktail, of course.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E6 — Mum's DayIt's a fun day of treats for Ree. After she makes Italian chicken soup for lunch and a cherry pie to set aside for dessert, Ree lets Ladd and the kids make a dinner of filet steaks, oven potatoes and roasted asparagus.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E7 — Kit and CaboodleRee's prepping four get-ahead meal kits, portioned and ready to go. For time-saving dinners, she prepares barbecue chicken pizza with spicy slaw, spicy veggie stir-fry, spinach Alfredo pasta bake and stuffed bell peppers.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E8 — Burning 101It's springtime, so Ladd's burning the pastures and Ree's making two days' worth of dinners with spicy jerk chicken, steak and bean burritos, and a crunchy corn salad. Juicy grilled peaches and pineapples are for dessert!

programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart...and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures warm, deep fried and frozen. And two Michelin starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London & South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north east regional title but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. Last year, Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. But Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and wagyu-angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. But all is not going to plan and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's 2 Michelin star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot.The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again, he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64 year reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. Judging the chefs' dishes are Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton and guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: North East Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the topspot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, `Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by Grime Music called `Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called `My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned `St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, `No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred `Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist DonnaTaggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with stunning dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to Grime. The rivals are cooking to impress food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver, plus guest judge and British music legend Martin Kemp.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios.They will be cooking for the judges food critic, Mathew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worth of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E2Emotions run high as the family host their first public event, while Marnie explains the importance of animal husbandry as she cares for orphaned lamb Aga. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Spain v Cape VerdeSpain v Cape Verde (Kick-off 5.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the opening match in Group H, held at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. With analysis from Juan Mata, Emma Hayes and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Arabia v Uruguay
programme.desc: S5 E10 — Saudi Arabia v UruguaySaudi Arabia v Uruguay (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' first match in Group H, held at Miami Stadium in the USA. The Saudis caused an upset against South American opposition in their opener four years ago in Qatar when they prevailed 2-1 against eventual champions Argentina, but defeats at the hands of Poland and Mexico ensured that 1994 remained the only time they had progressed beyond the group stage, when the tournament was also held in the USA. Uruguay lifted the trophy in 1930 and 1950, but their run of three consecutive appearances in the knockout stage came to an end in 2022, when they failed to make it out of a group containing Portugal, South Korea and Ghana. The sides also met in the group stage of the 2018 tournament, when a goal by Luis Suarez gave the Uruguayans a 1-0 win. With analysis from Duncan Ferguson, Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: Episode 1: Defend & Attack - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: The season begins, and a new king reigns. But on the brutal icy roads of the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo, legends and rivals are closing in. WRC More than Machine Season 2 is here!

programme.title: Episode 2: Now or Never - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: It's Now or Never! Rally Sweden’s icy roads and Safari Rally Kenya’s wild terrain push drivers to their limits. Rivals clash, teams strategise, and every second counts. Episode 2 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 3: Vanishing Point - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Toyota dominates early rallies, Hyundai fights for glory, and Neuville seeks redemption. Ogier's part-time run heats up the battle. Can the Manufacturers' Championship finally shift? EP3 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 4: Resilience - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With the new kid on the block Martins Sesks showing impressive pace, Adrien and Gregoire begin to feel the pressure as this rising star pushes them to the limits. In this episode of More than Machine, the talented 24-year-old and his teammates at M-Sport take on some of the most challenging stages of the season – Poland and Latvia.

programme.title: Episode 5: Cause and Effect - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: As M-Sport races towards the end of the season in Finland and Greece, tensions start to turn to securing drivers for next year. In episode five of More Than Machine, Adrien Fourmaux considers what it will take to be a world champion—and with which team.

programme.title: Episode 6: Let the Games Begin - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With sights set on 2025, the M-Sport team tests their potential drivers for the upcoming season, determined to find their next leading contender. In episode six of More than Machine, step behind the scenes to see how M-Sport's young drivers strive to prove themselves at the crunch point of the season.

programme.title: Episode 7: Fortune Favours the Brave - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With everything on the line, bold risks and fearless moves will give you the crown. The moment where legends are forged and history is made. Don’t miss the epic conclusion of More Than Machine S2!

programme.title: Piccadilly Third Stop

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Aigues-Mortes - Crime à Aigues-Mortes. 2015. Director: Claude-Michel Rome. Stars Florence Pernel And Samuel Labarthe. Murder victims turn out to be suspects in an old unresolved crime. [S]

programme.title: Round the Ring Birmingham History
programme.desc: ...Birmingham History. 1975. A fascinating look at the history of Birmingham, from the very beginning to the modern city of the 1970's and the changes that have taken place.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Koffee 'n Kreme. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E03)

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. The Fun-Fun Killer. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. Honey and Sam investigate the murder of a toy manufacturer.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Dead Letter. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson And Iain Cuthbertson. A large UXB in the London Underground brings Ash face-to-face with a new type of fuse.

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Jackson's Assassination. 1957. Stars Scott Forbes, Perry Lopez And Leslie Kimmell. Jim becomes inadvertently involved in a plot to assassinate President Jackson. [S]

programme.title: Noose
programme.desc: 1948. Crime drama starring Derek Farr, Carole Landis And Stanley Holloway. Sugiani, a black-market racketeer (Joseph Calleia), is amassing a fortune until reporter Linda Medbury is on to him. [S]

programme.title: The Treasure of San Teresa
programme.desc: 1959. War. Director: Alvin Rakoff. Stars Eddie Constantine, Dawn Addams, Marius Goring, Christopher Lee. Ex-serviceman, Larry, returns to Europe to retrieve jewels hidden from the Nazis in 1944. [S]

programme.title: The Woman Who Came Back
programme.desc: 1945. Horror. Directed by Walter Colmes. Stars John Loder, Nancy Kelly And Otto Kruger. A woman returns to her hometown and becomes convinced that she has been possessed by a witch's spirit. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: A Study in Panic
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Roy Kellino. Stars Dick Powell, Dorothy Malone And George Eldredge. A newspaper columnist is threatened by a disgruntled reader after writing a column which makes fun of men. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Great Pearl Robbery. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt And Charles Morgan. Marriott investigates after a pearl necklace, worth £130,000, goes missing. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Golden Wheel. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard And Jennifer Jayne. Having discovered where the resistance hides its funds, Gessler make plans to stop further money reaching them. [S]

programme.title: The Hellbenders
programme.desc: 1967. Western. Director: Sergio Corbucci. Stars Joseph Cotten, Norma Bengell And Julian Mateos. The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas has a plan to revive the Confederacy. [S]

programme.title: Jimmy Somerville: Smalltown Boy
programme.desc: 2025. Director: Olivier Simonnet. Meet pop icon Jimmy Somerville who left his mark on the 1980s. He has had a lasting influence on British pop without ever betraying his own identity.

programme.title: Rebecca
programme.desc: Part 1. 1997. Stars Charles Dance, Diana Rigg And Faye Dunaway. A young woman marries a wealthy widower but soon discovers both he and his household are haunted by the memory of his late first wife. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Fire Rock. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert And Delia Williams. Chris Cobb discovers one of his depot managers has gone missing. He was last seen in an area known for strange happenings. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Never-Never Affair. 1968. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Leo G. Carroll. An U.N.C.L.E translator recruited to become a courier. Things go askew when she is given sensitive information. [S]

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
